record.recall_text:
For a simply supported beam, draw the free-body diagram first.

Use the sum of moments about one support to find the other reaction, then use vertical force balance. The reactions must add up to the applied load.

I can explain the balance of forces. I want another example to check my shear-force sign convention.
record.to_review_text: Work through one shear-force diagram without looking at the solution.

captureHarnessCorrection: The rest form retained its five-minute duration. The harness had a shorter wait; stopping its launcher also closed the QA child. Focus and Recall were preserved, and the unfinished Rest was resumed through normal UI recovery with closed time excluded. No clock or stored duration was edited.

images.description: Home: subjects, a session goal, the study calendar and a parked study question.
Focus: the compact panel at 19:24 of the same session.
Recall: an explanation after twenty minutes of Focus, with one question to revisit.
Rest: the actual countdown in a five-minute break.
History: the completed session card and recall excerpt, preserved after restart.
Learn: an illustrated idea and a practical next step.
Appearance: independent light and dark choices in Ink Dim.

method: Direct Chromium compositor captures at exactly 2 output pixels per CSS pixel, normal UI scale. Recall, Rest, History and Appearance are unretouched detail crops. No image resampling, DOM edits, clock mocking or fabricated records.
